name: Mycelium
description: Self-healing web data network. All data is verified before serving.

endpoints./export.json?source=N: latest verified rows per source (omit source for all)
endpoints./history?source=N: full time series: every verified run's rows for one source
endpoints./runs?source=N&limit=M: run log: verdicts and row counts
endpoints./incidents: every break: symptom, machine-written heal prompt, gates, decision
endpoints./new?hours=N: programs first seen since baseline — the first-submission signal
endpoints./newest?limit=N&per=M: newest-first with reward; per=M gives the M latest from each platform. Each row carries recency: published (platform printed a date), observed (watcher saw it arrive), listed (platform order only). The global list omits listed rows.
endpoints./top?limit=N&per=M: highest-reward programs; per=M caps how many each platform contributes
endpoints./signals: aggregate vectors: top bounty, median, count above 10k, new this week
endpoints./watchlist: what each source tracks, and when its baseline was seeded
endpoints./reliability: fleet totals, heal rate, mean recovery
